content:
sam: heads-up: deploy-bot blocked the RC publish for `api-backend:rc-0307` during the release window. error says attestation TTL expired for the existing tag.

deploy-bot: publish-blocked: existing tag `api-backend:rc-0307` has attestation with timestamp older than allowed TTL (provenance: cosign). policy prevents reuse of tag with expired attestation.

sam: we pushed the RC yesterday; CI re-ran a security scan today which rotated the attestation timestamp unexpectedly. it looks like the attestation service's clock skew caused TTL to appear expired.

nicole: do we have the two digests and their attestations? need to know if it's the same image or a different build.

sam: digests: `sha256:1111aaaa...` (current in registry) vs `sha256:2222bbbb...` (our intended RC). both were attempted to bear `rc-0307`.

qa: if the registry has a different digest under the tag we must be careful. rolling canary would hit different code than tested.

sre: quick check: run `cosign verify` on both attestations and check timestamp and signer ID. also check attestation TTL config in provenance-store.

sam: ran quick verify. current tag `sha256:1111aaaa` attestation signer is `ci-signer@redwood` and timestamp is 2026-03-05T23:58:00Z, TTL policy 48h -> expired. intended digest `sha256:2222bbbb` has fresh attestation from 2026-03-07T10:12:00Z.

release-manager: timeline: release window open 3h more. we need to decide: (A) overwrite tag after reattesting the intended digest and re-signing; (B) retag intended digest to a fresh rc label (rc-0307-1) and pin promotion to digest; (C) rollback candidate to previous stable if we can't safely resolve before cutoff.

nicole: option A is dangerous because we must ensure we don't accidentally change the attestation for the existing digest. and deploy-bot policy prohibits tag rebinds without provenance reconciliation.

qa: option B preferred for speed: create `rc-0307-ephemeral` pointing to `sha256:2222bbbb`, run canary. must make sure release notes mention ephemeral tag->digest mapping.

sre: agree B for safety. also open an incident for the attestation TTL drift (clock skew). we should not change TTL policy mid-release.

sam: if we retag, deploy-bot will still require an attestation for the new tag. I can copy the attestation for `sha256:2222bbbb` or re-run signing. which is allowed?

deploy-bot: policy: attestations must be created by an approved signer. copying raw attestation file across tags is not sufficient; re-signing using the CI signer is required.

sam: CI signer ephemeral key is available; I'll trigger a re-sign job for `sha256:2222bbbb` and then push `rc-0307-ephemeral` tag with new attestation.

release-manager: make sure the release notes and the release page reference the digest explicitly and warn downstream teams that rc-0307 remains pinned to digest `sha256:2222bbbb` for promotion.

qa: after re-sign, I'll run the same regression suite against canary. timeline: 20 minutes for resign & push, 10 minutes for deploy, 15 for smoke/regression.

sre: in parallel, I'll run audit for any other tags whose attestation TTL is near expiry to avoid another surprise.

sam: resigned and pushed: `aws ecr put-image --repository-name api-backend --image-tag rc-0307-ephemeral --image-manifest $(aws ecr batch-get-image --repository-name api-backend --image-ids imageDigest=sha256:2222bbbb --query images[0].imageManifest --output text)` plus cosign sign step completed. deploy-bot should pick it up.

deploy-bot: new publish accepted for tag `rc-0307-ephemeral` pointing to sha256:2222bbbb with valid attestation from `ci-signer@redwood`.

qa: canary deploy started. running acceptance tests. so far no regressions. :thumbsup:

release-manager: decision: promote using pinned digest `sha256:2222bbbb` once canary completes. update release notes: include why `rc-0307` tag was not used (attestation TTL drift) and the ephemeral tag used for verification. add follow-up action to SRE for TTL-clock investigation.

sre: filed internal incident INC-2026-78: "provenance TTL drift / attestation clock skew" and assigned to infra team.

nicole: small ops note for release notes: include exact digest URIs, e.g., `account.dkr.ecr.us-west-1.amazonaws.com/api-backend@sha256:2222bbbb...` and the ephemeral tag mapping.

sam: release notes updated. pinned promotion to digest completed. closing thread after post-release retrospective.

release-manager: thanks team. postmortem action items: 1) add TTL-monitoring alert; 2) harden CI signer clock sync; 3) avoid relying on mutable date/named tags for promotion; 4) document emergency manual resign workflow.

sam: noted. closing. :white_check_mark:
